definitions.gloss: number of pages; page count; total pages
definitions.explanation: The total count of pages in a book, document, report, thesis, or printed material. Used when referring to the length or volume of written content, often in contexts like publishing, academic writing, printing, and office work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ページ{数|すう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many pages does this book have?

examples.japanese: ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ページ{数|すう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: My report doesn't have enough pages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ページ{数|すう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My paper has exceeded the page limit, so I need to cut some of the content.

notes:
Compound of the loanword ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧ ('page') and the suffix {〜数|すう} ('number of; count of'), which attaches productively to many nouns to mean 'number of X': ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧ ('number of people'), ⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧ ('number of times'), ⟦{件数|けんすう}→件数：28808_kensuu⟧ ('number of cases'), and so on.

USAGE:
- Refers to a count, not to individual page numbers. For 'page number' (e.g., 'page 12'), use ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ or simply specify the page with "○○⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧".
- Frequently appears with verbs of quantity: ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ ('large'), ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ ('few'), ⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ / ⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ ('enough / not enough'), ⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧ ('to exceed'), ⟦{制限|せいげん}する→制限する：19636_seigensuru⟧ ('to limit').
- Very common in academic, publishing, and office contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ページ{数|すう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many pages
- ページ{数|すう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: to have few pages
- ページ{数|すう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count the number of pages
- ページ{数|すう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: page limit
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ページ{数|すう}: total number of pages
- ページ{数|すう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: the page count grows

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: page number — the numeric label on a specific page, not the total count.
- ⟦{文字数|もじすう}→文字数：29489_mojisuu⟧: character count — another measure of document length, tied to characters rather than pages.
- ⟦{枚数|まいすう}→枚数：13143_maisuu⟧: number of sheets — used for loose paper, documents, or tickets, not for bound pages.
- ⟦{分量|ぶんりょう}→分量：05474_bunryou⟧: amount; volume — a more general word for the overall size or quantity of content.
